_fixture.source: GET /api/rig/check?driver_id=1 on the live pitwall service (read-only), 2026-10-11
_fixture.note: recorded: the latest checkable session (a real GT7 session on an unidentified circuit); many unknowns

metrics.label: Brake at rest
metrics.detail: Highest brake reading during 6 s of full throttle on straights; above 0.5% for 0.0 s.

metrics.label: Throttle at rest
metrics.detail: Lowest throttle reading of each lap (worst lap shown): the pedal should return to 0.
metrics.threshold_note: The research target is exactly 0; pitwall passes up to 0.5% because 12-bit pedals read a few thousandths at rest (0.002% on the real PS5 race).

metrics.label: Full throttle reached
metrics.detail: 99th percentile of throttle on straights, lowest lap shown. GT7 may report throttle after traction control (unverified): a low peak may not be the pedal.
metrics.threshold_note: The 90% limit is sourced for F1 25 since v1.25 (S Mode/DRS needs throttle above 90%); the 99% target is a pitwall heuristic.

metrics.label: Full brake in heavy stops
metrics.detail: No braking zone started above 250 km/h.
metrics.reason_unknown: No braking zone started above 250 km/h.

metrics.label: Braking time at 100%
metrics.good_range: <= ~30% of braking time overall; no flat tops concentrated in low-speed corners with lock-ups [H]
metrics.detail: Share of 4.3 s of braking spent at 100% over 4 braking events; 0 plateaus at 100% longer than 0.3 s in slow corners (below 120 km/h).

metrics.label: Time to peak brake
metrics.good_range: close to the driver's own best laps; ACC GT3 reference 0.31-0.38 s
metrics.target: Compare with your own sessions (ACC GT3 0.31-0.38 s (Joyce et al. 2025); not F1)
metrics.detail: Median time from brake onset to peak over 4 braking events (middle half 0.36-1.43 s).
metrics.reference: ACC GT3 0.31-0.38 s (Joyce et al. 2025); not F1

metrics.label: Trail-brake release
metrics.good_range: close to the driver's own best laps; ACC GT3 reference 0.94-1.26 s
metrics.target: Compare with your own sessions (ACC GT3 0.94-1.26 s (Joyce et al. 2025); not F1)
metrics.detail: Median time from the last moment at peak brake to release over 4 braking events (middle half 0.17-0.44 s).
metrics.reference: ACC GT3 0.94-1.26 s (Joyce et al. 2025); not F1

metrics.label: Brake re-applications
metrics.detail: Braking events per lap where the brake fell by at least 10 points and was pressed 10+ points again before being released (a full release starts a new press), over 2 laps with measured stops.

metrics.label: Lock-ups at 100% brake
metrics.detail: Not applicable to this game: measured for EA SPORTS F1 25 (incl. 2026 Season Pack) only.
metrics.reason_unknown: Not applicable to this game: measured for EA SPORTS F1 25 (incl. 2026 Season Pack) only.

metrics.label: DRS closed by a light brake touch
metrics.detail: Not applicable to this game: measured for EA SPORTS F1 25 (incl. 2026 Season Pack) only.
metrics.reason_unknown: Not applicable to this game: measured for EA SPORTS F1 25 (incl. 2026 Season Pack) only.

metrics.label: Brake peak drift in the session
metrics.detail: Needs at least 6 single-press stops entered above 250 km/h; found 0.
metrics.reason_unknown: Needs at least 6 single-press stops entered above 250 km/h; found 0.
metrics.threshold_note: Median peak of the last three firm stops minus the first three (single-press stops entered above 250 km/h, at least six). The research compares stops 8-10 with stops 1-3 at a similar entry speed; on real races that mixed light lifts with full stops and drift came out at +-30 points from driving alone, so pitwall compares firm stops only. The fail limit is a pitwall heuristic.

metrics.label: Brake noise in steady holds
metrics.detail: No steady brake holds of 0.3 s or more between 5% and 97%.
metrics.reason_unknown: No steady brake holds of 0.3 s or more between 5% and 97%.
metrics.threshold_note: The threshold is for the load cell; with the Hall brake the value is shown for comparison only.

metrics.label: Heavy-stop peak against your history
metrics.good_range: within 0.10 of the driver's history at the same BRF [H]
metrics.detail: Load Cell Kit only: this session used the Hall brake.
metrics.reason_unknown: Load Cell Kit only: this session used the Hall brake.

metrics.label: Time at full lock
metrics.good_range: ~0 outside hairpins (Monaco hairpin needs ~21-22 deg road-wheel lock vs ~17 deg normally) [H]
metrics.detail: GT7 steering is normalised to a nominal 900 deg and the car's AUTO lock is not in telemetry, so full lock and % of lock are unknown. Pass the car's lock-to-lock rotation to measure it.
metrics.reason_unknown: GT7 steering is normalised to a nominal 900 deg and the car's AUTO lock is not in telemetry, so full lock and % of lock are unknown. Pass the car's lock-to-lock rotation to measure it.

metrics.detail: Not applicable to this game: measured for EA SPORTS F1 25 (incl. 2026 Season Pack) only.

metrics.label: Steering oscillation on straights
metrics.target: Compare with your own sessions (Uncalibrated: hands-on driving already produces small corrections. Compare before and after a change (for example the Boost Kit).)
metrics.detail: 13 steering reversals larger than 1.8 deg (GT7 nominal 900 deg scale) in 5.1 s of near-centre straight-line driving (low-pass 10 Hz). Hands-on corrections count too: compare before and after a change.
metrics.reference: Uncalibrated: hands-on driving already produces small corrections. Compare before and after a change (for example the Boost Kit).

metrics.label: Oscillation after a session change
metrics.detail: Not applicable to this game: measured for EA SPORTS F1 25 (incl. 2026 Season Pack) only.
metrics.reason_unknown: Not applicable to this game: measured for EA SPORTS F1 25 (incl. 2026 Season Pack) only.
metrics.threshold_note: Bursts of 3+ steering reversals larger than 10% of lock while standing still or with no pedal input, in the first 30 s of the session's first lap (pitwall heuristic; standing still is added to the research definition because drivers rev on the grid). Paused and garage frames are not recorded.

metrics.label: Steering reversal rate
metrics.good_range: driver-relative; racing gap size must be calibrated on recordings (driver-workload gaps of 0.5-0.7 deg are too small)
metrics.target: Compare with your own sessions (Driver-relative smoothness indicator (Markkula & Engstrom 2006). Compare with your own best sessions.)
metrics.detail: 123 steering reversals of at least 2 deg (low-pass 2 Hz, GT7 steering on its nominal 900 deg scale) in 1.2 min.
metrics.reference: Driver-relative smoothness indicator (Markkula & Engstrom 2006). Compare with your own best sessions.

notes: Telemetry carries the game's processed inputs (probably after in-game deadzone, linearity and saturation; unverified). It cannot show pedal force, BRF or SEN.
Neither F1 25 nor GT7 sends force-feedback torque, so clipping and FFB strength cannot be measured here.
Thresholds marked H are pitwall heuristics, not published values. Use them to compare sessions, before and after a change.

GT7: steering is on a nominal 900 deg scale and the car's AUTO lock is not in telemetry, so time at full lock and centre offset are unknown (informational when a lock is given); oscillation and reversal rates are informational, with thresholds converted to wheel degrees on that nominal scale.
GT7: the throttle and brake values may be the output after TCS/ABS rather than the pedal (open question 13), so a low throttle or brake peak may not be the pedal.
